concerns.text: Task T014 (Descriptor Calculation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. It implements FR-002 (calculate TPSA, Rotatable Bond Count, MW, Aromatic Ring Count, Wiener Index, Zagreb Index). Without this task being actionable, the spec requirement FR-002 has no implementation path.

Task T035c (Artifact Verification Fix) is marked as unchecked [ ]. It is required to satisfy the verification logic for US3 (FR-007/FR-006) regarding file existence and content validation. Missing this task leaves the reporting phase incomplete.

Task T055 (Full Pipeline Smoke Test) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This is the critical integration task for US1-US3. Without it, there is no task covering the end-to-end execution verification required by the plan's 'Final Integration' phase.

Task T080 (Strict Data Source Enforcement) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan explicitly requires pinning dataset versions in `data/config.yaml` (Constitution Principle I). This task is the only one addressing that requirement; its unchecked status means the requirement is unimplemented.

Task T081 (Standard Condition Definition Rigor) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan requires defining 'Standard' conditions via config file. This task is the sole implementation of that requirement; without it, the plan element is unmet.

Task T082 (Pipeline Exit Code Verification) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan requires strict execution boundaries and exit code verification. This task is the only one covering this safety constraint.
Task T083 (Report Content Validation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan requires a self-check for mandatory report sections. This task is the only one covering this requirement.
Task T084 (Data File Integrity Check) is marked as unchecked [ ]. The plan requires post-execution file size verification. This task is the only one covering this data hygiene requirement.
